label: phishing
vector_reason: The message asks the recipient to sign in and the link imitates Microsoft.

evidence.title: Reply-To mismatch
evidence.detail: Replies go to ms-account-verify.com, not microsoft.com.

evidence.title: DMARC failed
evidence.detail: microsoft.com did not authenticate this message.

advice: Replies would go to ms-account-verify.com, not microsoft.com. Don't reply; contact the sender through a channel you already know.
The link goes to micros0ft-login.com, which imitates microsoft.com. Don't click it. Type microsoft.com into your browser instead.
Report it with the Report Phish button, then delete it.
